canonical_source.behavior: When CsvRowSelector is absent and ExportRequested has a delegate, the visible Export control is disabled for an empty filtered collection and forwards a cloned SortedItems collection to the consumer callback without mutating source state.

semantics: the existing Site Operations export remains the single visible export action
the generic AppDataGrid ExportRequested contract receives the current authoritative filtered row collection
the callback receives a cloned row list in current display order
the callback is not invoked for an empty filtered collection
the consumer performs the existing real CSV browser download
no persistence, WordPress, queue, cache, billing, or secret mutation is introduced

security.tenant_context: auth + tenant.context with tenant-scoped SiteOperationHistory reads

terminality.basis: The Laravel production export action now executes the canonical AppDataGrid ExportRequested callback contract against real tenant-scoped Site Operations rows before the existing CSV consumer runs; focused tests prove exact identity, callback/empty semantics, and tenant/permission fail-closed behavior.
